decisions.reason: The retained 7 cm and 17 cm block-pareo border options also apply to the mustard pareo, but its existing message-34 MODIFY already records the complete update.
The 7 cm and 17 cm measurements concern the block-colour pareos, not the basket-weave print; the separate no-border decision for the weave is already represented by its own message-34 MODIFY.
The block-pareo border-width options do not apply to the Zebra print; its independently stated option, scale, and no-border changes are already captured by its message-34 MODIFY.
Retaining the block-pareo border widths does not change colour-calibration requirements; the Pantone and production-colour clause is a separate decision already represented.
The block-pareo border-width decision does not alter output readiness, CMYK mode, seamless-repeat construction, or file-format scope.

The 7 cm and 17 cm values are design-specific block-pareo border options rather than general artwork dimensions; the independently confirmed 1.5 cm seam allowance and rolled hem are already represented.
Retaining the block-pareo border widths does not change the technical sheet's documented colour-reference requirement.
